bugs.creator: kevinushey
bugs.summary: Add R_mapEnv as internal C helper for iterating over environment values

comments.creator: kevinushey
comments.text:
Created attachment 3639
Proposed implementation of R_mapEnv.

The goal here is to provide a C API for iterating over bindings in a primitive R environment, without exposing internals of the environment itself.

comments.creator: luke
comments.text: This may be related to the binding API develed in bug 18928.

comments.creator: lionel.hry
kevinushey
comments.text:
Created attachment 3656
Patch.

Incorporates Lionel's suggestion to allow the caller to decide whether or not they want to resolve a binding value. Includes a slot for the value in the iterator, to allow for faster resolution for normal bindings.

comments.text: For the iterator I would just like to express a preference for either a full accessor API (preferred), or just a value accessor. A partial API with just the active binding accessor feels incomplete.
